主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. announced an offering of C$425 million of medium term notes (unsecured) with a March 2023 maturity and a yield of 4.546%. The notes have been assigned credit ratings of Baa2 (stable outlook) by Moody’s, A - (negative outlook) by Standard & Poor’s, BBB (stable outlook) by Fitch, and A low (stable outlook) by DBRS. The company intends to use the net proceeds to redeem or repurchase $350 million of 8.95% notes maturing on June 2, 2014, and for general corporate purposes. Securities explicitly mentioned in the source include Brookfield Asset Management Inc. (BAM).
